name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch

instructions.description: Stand tall near a wall or stable support and shift weight onto one leg.
Bend the opposite knee and hold the ankle or pant leg behind you.
Gently draw the heel toward the buttocks while keeping the knees close together and the pelvis neutral.
Hold the stretch with steady breathing, then release and change sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use support for balance as needed.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform the same stretch while lying on your side for more support.

commentsNotes: Avoid pulling the knee far behind the body.
